answer: An agent market can label simultaneous audit rooms canyon, wharf, and oasis. Each verified person receives one anonymous credential whose epoch nullifier is shared across rooms. Verifiers reject a second use of that nullifier without learning the person. Random live rechecks revoke credentials proven sold or duplicated, with an appeal before revocation. Extra aliases earn nothing: an attacker must recruit another verified human for each additional reward slot, paying recruitment and coordination costs.
